We are looking for a hands-on Paid Media & Tracking Assistant to support our digital advertising, analytics, and tracking efforts across multiple paid media platforms. The ideal candidate has practical experience setting up, maintaining, and troubleshooting advertising pixels, events, conversion tracking, and analytics systems, with a strong understanding of how paid traffic is measured and optimized.
You will work closely with the marketing team to ensure that campaigns are properly tracked, conversions are accurately recorded, and our tracking infrastructure provides reliable data for reporting and optimization. This role is particularly suited to someone who enjoys working directly with ad platforms, analytics tools, event tracking, and campaign data rather than focusing solely on strategy.
Key Responsibilities

• 
Set up, manage, and troubleshoot Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

• 
Support paid advertising campaigns across platforms such as Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

• 
Define and maintain a clear event tracking structure, including event names, parameters, properties, and conversion definitions.

• 
Implement and validate pixels, events, conversion tracking, UTM parameters, and other tracking solutions across websites and campaigns.

• 
Work with the tracking stack, including PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Events Manager, Brevo, and Microsoft Clarity.

• 
Monitor tracking performance and investigate discrepancies between advertising platforms, analytics tools, and website data.

• 
Debug tracking issues and identify why an event or conversion is not firing correctly, rather than only setting up campaigns.

• 
Test and validate events across different platforms to ensure that data is being captured accurately and consistently.

• 
Ensure that key events and conversions are properly defined, recorded, and attributed across the relevant platforms.

• 
Assist with campaign setup, audience tracking, retargeting, and conversion measurement.

• 
Analyze campaign and tracking data to identify potential issues and opportunities for improvement.

• 
Work with websites, landing pages, and analytics tools to ensure proper data collection and attribution.

• 
Help maintain organized tracking documentation and ensure that event naming and tracking structures remain consistent.

• 
Stay up to date with changes to advertising platforms, tracking technologies, attribution, and privacy requirements.

• 
Support testing and troubleshooting of new tracking setups before campaigns go live.

Preferred Experience

• 
Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

• 
Experience with TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

• 
Practical experience with PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Microsoft Clarity, and Brevo.

• 
Strong understanding of event tracking concepts, including event names, parameters, properties, conversion definitions, and attribution.

• 
Experience troubleshooting tracking issues and identifying why events or conversions may not be firing, recording, or attributing correctly.

• 
Familiarity with server-side tracking / Conversions API is a strong plus.

• 
Experience with newer or emerging advertising platforms, including ChatGPT Ads, would be a significant advantage.

• 
Comfortable working with data, spreadsheets, dashboards, and campaign performance reports.

• 
Strong attention to detail and a hands-on, problem-solving mindset.

What We’re Looking For
We are looking for someone who is practical, detail-oriented, and technically curious. You should be comfortable getting into the actual ad platforms and tracking tools, testing events yourself, investigating discrepancies, and figuring out why something is not working as expected.
The ideal candidate should be able to go beyond simply setting up campaigns or implementing pixels. They should understand how the entire tracking flow works, from defining an event and its parameters to ensuring that it fires correctly, is captured by the relevant analytics tools, and is ultimately reflected as a meaningful conversion.
You do not need to be an advanced developer, but you should be confident working with tracking tools, advertising platforms, basic website elements, and analytics systems. Experience working across multiple paid media channels and the ability to quickly learn and troubleshoot new platforms are highly valued.

About the job:

Data Analyst - Autonomous Vehicle (AV) Operations & Infrastructure

Role: Data Analyst AV Support Data Infrastructure & Analytics

Experience: 46 Years

Location: Remote / Flexible

Industry: Global Tech & Mobility Leader

About the Team & Opportunity

Our team owns the end-to-end data foundation driving autonomous vehicle (AV) support operations for one of the world's leading mobility platforms. Every operational metric, real-time rider contact, automated data-quality check, and pre-launch feature instrumentation flows through the systems we architect.

We sit directly at the intersection of AV Program Teams, Operational Analytics, and Core Data Engineering to turn complex operational data into actionable, trustworthy insights.

Preferred Qualifications

AV / Autonomous Systems Interest: Understanding of or genuine curiosity about how autonomous trip operations and support models work.Semantic & Metric Layers: Experience with dbt, LookML, or proprietary metric management systems.Streaming & Real-Time Analytics: Familiarity with Kafka, Flink, Pinot, or real-time event processing.Orchestration & Observability: Hands-on experience with Airflow and data observability tools.Dashboarding & Apps: Proficiency with Tableau, Streamlit, Retool, or custom internal tool suites.

1ee3091227625304.description: Company DescriptionAbstrabit is a Private AI engineering company building AI-powered products and solutions for businesses. We work across the AI stack from deploying and evaluating private and open-weight models to building production applications, agents, workflows, and integrations on top of them. Our engineering work is organized across two closely connected layers: the AI layer, focused on models, inference, evaluation, and AI infrastructure; and the application layer, focused on building reliable, scalable software products that use those AI capabilities. The Context AI models are only one part of a production AI system. They still need applications around them APIs, workflows, user interfaces, authentication, databases, integrations, monitoring, and reliable production infrastructure. Our Software Engineering team owns this application layer. As we build more AI-powered products, we are looking for engineers who want to become strong software developers while working close to modern AI systems. Job DescriptionAs a Software Engineering Intern, you will work primarily on the application layer of our AI products. You will build frontend and backend features, APIs, integrations, workflows, and other product components that connect with AI models and inference services. You will work with experienced engineers on real production systems using technologies such as TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, databases, APIs, and cloud services. You will also gain exposure to how systems such as LLMs, RAG pipelines, AI agents, and private model inference are integrated into production applications. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will be expected to write code, debug problems, understand the systems you are working on, and gradually take ownership of larger pieces of the product. What You'll Work On Depending on the project, you may work on: Building frontend and backend product features. Designing and consuming REST APIs and internal services. Working with databases, authentication, file storage, and third-party integrations. Connecting applications with AI models, inference APIs, RAG systems, and AI agents. Debugging application issues across frontend, backend, and integrations. Writing tests and improving the reliability of existing features. Deploying and maintaining applications using cloud platforms and modern deployment tools. Reviewing your work with experienced engineers and improving it based on technical feedback. You will not be restricted to isolated internship exercises. The objective is for you to contribute to software that is actually being built and used. QualificationsWe care more about your engineering fundamentals and ability to learn than the number of frameworks listed on your resume. You should have: Good programming fundamentals and problem-solving ability. Working knowledge of at least one programming language. Basic understanding of web applications, APIs, databases, and Git. Experience building at least one meaningful software project through coursework, a personal project, internship, hackathon, or similar work. Ability to understand existing code and make changes to it. Willingness to investigate problems instead of stopping at the first solution that appears to work. Ability to communicate clearly when you are stuck, disagree with an approach, or need more context. Familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, or similar technologies will help, but we do not expect interns to already know our complete technology stack. Using AI as an Engineer We use AI tools as part of our engineering workflow, and you are welcome to use them. We do not evaluate engineers based on how much code they can type from memory. Role Overview

ITI Digital is seeking a Client Success Manager to serve as the primary relationship manager for a diverse portfolio of clients across our DXP platform and managed destination websites. This portfolio includes Destination Management Organizations (DMOs), regional tourism boards, Chambers of Commerce, parks & recreation departments, government agencies, and economic development organizations. A background working with or for these types of organizations is central to this role.

This is an active, day-to-day account management position. The Client Success Manager personally conducts onboarding calls, manages ongoing client engagements, monitors product adoption, and leads the renewal process. The role owns a defined core book of accounts directly and provides day-to-day direction to a small team of Client Success Specialists across the team's combined account portfolio. In addition to direct account responsibilities, this role contributes to process refinement and serves as an internal representative of client needs in product and strategy discussions. This is a hands-on, collaborative role rather than a removed management position.

Preferred Background

The ideal candidate brings direct familiarity with the organizations ITI Digital serves, along with an understanding of the digital tools that support them. Relevant experience may include one or more of the following:

• 

Experience within a Destination Management or Marketing Organization (DMO), government agency, or economic development organization in a marketing, digital, or partnership capacity

• 

Experience selling marketing services, digital platforms, or SaaS solutions to destinations, tourism boards, parks & recreation departments, government agencies, or economic development organizations from an agency or vendor perspective

• 

Familiarity with co-op programs, visitor guide campaigns, itinerary tools, virtual visitor centers, or digital engagement platforms used by public-sector or destination marketing organizations

• 

An understanding of the operational environment of public-sector and quasi-public organizations, including board reporting cycles, grant-funded budgets, fiscal year planning, and multi-stakeholder decision-making processes

• 

A genuine understanding of how these organizations operate — and the ability to translate that understanding into thoughtful, consultative account management — will be a distinguishing quality in this role

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales-to-CS Handoff & CRM Stewardship

This area of responsibility focuses on ensuring a smooth transition from Sales and maintaining accurate data across client management systems.

• 

Maintain CRM company and deal records up-to-date with client information; flag gaps and align with Sales as needed

• 

Manage the client management platform configuration, including lifecycle stages, health scores, and onboarding playbooks

• 

Lead periodic reviews of the client management platform database to ensure accuracy, clean segmentation, and up-to-date client records

• 

Serve as the primary CS point of contact for platform questions, configuration updates, and vendor best practices

2. New Client Onboarding Ownership

The Client Success Manager is responsible for guiding new clients through a structured, milestone-driven onboarding process across our DXP platform and managed destination websites.

• 

Conduct welcome calls and kickoff meetings, drawing on destination industry experience to establish meaningful rapport with clients

• 

Clarify package scope, delivery timelines, and client-side resource commitments in accessible, straightforward terms

• 

Coordinate with Implementation and Technical Support specialists to track milestone completion; escalate blockers proactively

• 

Provide product demonstrations tailored to client use cases, connecting features to real workflows relevant to the client's organization type

• 

Deliver a formal end-of-onboarding notification and satisfaction survey; document lessons learned for playbook improvement

3. Subscription Engagement & Product Adoption Strategy & Support

This area of responsibility centers on developing and sustaining strong client relationships throughout the subscription period, with a focus on long-term engagement and product adoption.

• 

Maintain direct ownership of an assigned core book spanning DMOs, government agencies, Parks & Recreation departments, and economic development organizations across their full subscription terms

• 

Conduct regular check-in cadences calibrated to client tier and account health

• 

Apply relevant industry knowledge to connect product features to client outcomes, including visitor center engagement metrics, grant reporting requirements, economic development KPIs, and co-op partner ROI

• 

Identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts and hand off to the Sales team for follow-through

• 

Proactively identify accounts showing signs of declining usage or key contact changes, and respond with appropriate education or outreach

• 

Share relevant case studies, benchmark data, and best practices from across the ITI Digital client base to support adoption

• 

Serve as an internal advocate for clients during product development discussions, translating sector-specific feedback into actionable product input

4. Client Health Monitoring & Risk Management

The Client Success Manager is expected to maintain a consistent, informed view of account health, identifying and addressing risks before they affect client satisfaction or retention.

• 

Maintain health scores in the client management platform using usage data, survey results, support ticket patterns, and relationship signals

• 

Conduct structured health-check conversations at defined intervals, especially during leadership transitions at client organizations

• 

Deploy satisfaction survey campaigns at key subscription milestones; analyze results and close the feedback loop with clients

• 

Classify at-risk accounts on early indicators — passive satisfaction, declining usage, key contact changes, budget or procurement signals, and client unresponsiveness — not solely on expressed dissatisfaction, and maintain a documented save plan for each

• 

Log client-reported technical issues and escalate for triage and engineering assignment

• 

Escalate at-risk accounts to leadership with a clear situation summary, documented save plan, and recommended course of action well ahead of the renewal date

 5. Renewal Management

Renewal management is a primary accountability of the Client Success Manager. This role carries direct responsibility for retained revenue across the assigned portfolio.

• 

Maintain a current, accurate renewal pipeline with visibility into upcoming contract end dates

• 

Initiate renewal conversations well in advance of contract end; identify and address concerns early to avoid late-stage risk

• 

Apply approved concession parameters for renewal negotiations; escalate any offer outside those boundaries prior to client communication

• 

Prepare renewal contracts (with admin support); track signature status and follow up as needed

• 

Escalate contract, pricing, or invoicing concerns to leadership with full account context and a recommended course of action

6. Team Collaboration, Coaching & Continuous Improvement

The Client Success Manager works closely with a small team of Client Success Specialists, providing day-to-day guidance, sharing best practices, and helping to ensure consistent quality across the team's client interactions.

• 

Provide day-to-day direction and support to Client Success Specialists, including guidance on client communication, issue resolution, and account management best practices

• 

Serve as a resource for the Specialists when navigating complex client situations, escalations, or unfamiliar account types

• 

Partner with Implementation, …
